question: Kafka Streams 4.3.2, Java 21. We are porting this topology from our service on Kafka Streams 3.4. Input topic auth-events: key is a session id, value an AuthEvent with userId() and result(), serde authEventSerde. Requirement: one alert per user and 5-minute window, sent only when the window's final count of FAILED logins is at least 5; events can arrive up to 1 minute late. On 3.4 we get several alerts per window (at counts 5, 6, 7 and so on), and the code no longer compiles against 4.3. Please write the 4.3 version and explain each change.
evidence:
KStream<String, AuthEvent> events =
    builder.stream("auth-events", Consumed.with(Serdes.String(), authEventSerde));
events.filter((k, v) -> v.result() == Result.FAILED)
      .groupBy((k, v) -> v.userId(), Grouped.with(Serdes.String(), authEventSerde))
      .windowedBy(TimeWindows.of(Duration.ofMinutes(5)).grace(Duration.ofMinutes(1)))
      .count()
      .filter((windowedUser, count) -> count >= 5)
      .toStream()
      .to("login-alerts");
